scripts.build:web: bun ./node_modules/expo/bin/cli export --platform web --output-dir web-build && bun scripts/build-service-worker.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy -c deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.dev: bun run build:web && node ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev -c deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --var PUBLIC_APP:true
scripts.db:local: bun ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 execute apartment-search-observations --local -c deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file deploy/cloudflare/schema.sql
scripts.deploy: bun run build:web && bun ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy -c deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:e2e: bun run typecheck && bun run build:web && bun run test && bun ./node_modules/playwright/cli.js test
